name: Trailing closures bind through a dedicated block channel

input.source_text: class A { public fun each(&block) -> Integer { block.call(7) } public fun plain(x) -> Integer { x } } module M { public fun run() -> Object { [A.new().each() { |x| x }, try { A.new().plain(1) { |y| y } } catch e { e }] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Trailing block binding has no native boundary.
